snippet.title: Pull of the Force | Fortnite Galactic Battle Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Sensing a disturbance in the Force, Leia and Luke will arrive on the Island May 8 alongside renowned smuggler Han Solo to offer you strategic services. 

Speaking of the Force, train in the Force some more! Hologram Mace Windu will appear, train with him to earn a Purple Lightsaber and learn Force Pull, which pulls in just about anything and anyone nearby. Rumor has it the Sith Lord Darth Maul will be around as a hologram as well, offering red lightsabers and teaching Force Throw. Pick up objects around you and throw them as projectiles!

Play Fortnite Battle Royale, the completely free 100-player PvP mode. One giant map, A Battle Bus, Last one standing wins. ESRB Rating: Teen with Violence.
